Shenzhen Mindray Animal Medical Technology Co., LTD. (short as Mindray Animal Medical), a new wholly-owned subsidiary of Mindray Group, is dedicated to bringing equal access to high-quality healthcare for animals.

Powered by the leading R&D capabilities, Mindray Animal Medical rolls out various products and solutions which meet the different demands of veterinarians to care for a wide variety of animals. 

We provide a broad portfolio of products that covers diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment of animals, with the aim to improve healthcare outcomes for animals and enhance confidence for animal caregivers.
